raw_block.rationale: Create a joint package for the two observed failure modes: clause-scoped statutory application and exact airline baggage-fee aggregation. Both helpers obtain all case facts and related rule parameters through joint current-source readers, avoiding case-answer lookup while preserving the native answer types.

skill.intent: Determine whether a current payment satisfies a termination-payment subclause requiring an employer-to-covered-payee payment made upon or after termination because of a source-listed reason.

inputs.name: payer_is_employer
inputs.question: Do the current facts establish that the payment's payer was the employer?

inputs.name: payee_category
inputs.question: What category describes the current payment recipient, such as employee, dependent, survivor, or estate?

inputs.name: payment_timing
inputs.question: How do the current facts categorize the payment's timing relative to termination?

inputs.name: termination_reason
inputs.question: What reason for termination is established by the current facts?

inputs.name: covered_payee_categories
inputs.question: Which payee categories are covered by the current clause's lead-in?

inputs.name: covered_payment_timings
inputs.question: Which payment-timing categories satisfy the current claimed subclause?

inputs.name: covered_termination_reasons
inputs.question: Which termination reasons satisfy the alternatives in the current claimed subclause?

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: The native binary label Entailment or Contradiction.

reads.question: Read the current facts and the precise scope of the claimed termination-payment subclause, returning normalized factual categories and all of that subclause's covered categories.
reads.source_locator: current native view public.source_text, public.facts, and public.question

fields.name: payer_is_employer
fields.question: Do the facts identify the payer as the employer?

fields.name: payee_category
fields.question: What is the recipient's factual category?

fields.name: payment_timing
fields.question: What is the payment's timing category relative to termination?

fields.name: termination_reason
fields.question: What factual reason caused the termination?

fields.name: covered_payee_categories
fields.question: What flat list of payee categories does the clause's lead-in cover?

fields.name: covered_payment_timings
fields.question: What flat list of timing categories does the claimed subclause cover?

fields.name: covered_termination_reasons
fields.question: What flat list of termination reasons does the claimed subclause cover?

source_obligations.statement: Check that the payment is by an employer to an employee or dependent within the clause's lead-in.

origin.quote: any payment or series of payments by an employer to an employee or any of his dependents

source_obligations.statement: Return Entailment when the covered payment was made upon or after termination because of death or retirement for disability; otherwise return Contradiction.

origin.quote: upon or after the termination of an employee's employment relationship because of (i) death, or (ii) retirement for disability

source_provenance.quote: any payment or series of payments by an employer to an employee or any of his dependents which is paid- (A) upon or after the termination of an employee's employment relationship because of (i) death, or (ii) retirement for disability

skill.intent: Calculate the exact integer ticket-plus-baggage total by classifying permitted cabin items, applying ordinal checked-bag fees, and combining route-specific size and weight charges.

inputs.name: ticket_price
inputs.question: What is the current ticket price?

inputs.name: bag_dimensions
inputs.question: What are the current bags' dimensions as one flat length-width-height array in listed order?

inputs.name: bag_weights
inputs.question: What are the current bags' weights in listed order?

inputs.name: personal_item_limits
inputs.question: What three per-axis dimension limits does the current source impose on a personal item?

inputs.name: carry_on_limits
inputs.question: What three per-axis dimension limits does the current source impose on a carry-on bag?

inputs.name: personal_item_count
inputs.question: How many ordinary personal items does the current source allow without checking?

inputs.name: carry_on_count
inputs.question: How many ordinary carry-on bags does the current source allow without checking?

inputs.name: checked_bag_fees
inputs.question: What are the matched cabin-and-route base checked-bag fees in ordinal order, with the final reusable fourth-plus rate last?

inputs.name: complimentary_bag_count
inputs.question: How many checked bags receive the current itinerary's complimentary-bag allowance?

inputs.name: standard_dimension_limit
inputs.question: What total outside-dimension limit applies to an ordinary checked bag?

inputs.name: complimentary_weight_limit
inputs.question: What weight limit applies to checked bags assigned the current complimentary allowance?

inputs.name: charged_weight_limit
inputs.question: What weight limit applies to current excess charged checked bags?

inputs.name: overweight_upper_bounds
inputs.question: What are the ascending upper weight bounds for the applicable overweight-fee bands?

inputs.name: overweight_fees
inputs.question: What fees correspond to the applicable overweight bands for the current route and cabin?

inputs.name: oversize_upper_bounds
inputs.question: What are the ascending total-dimension upper bounds for the applicable oversize bands?

inputs.name: oversize_fees
inputs.question: What fees correspond to the applicable oversize bands for the current route?

inputs.name: use_higher_size_or_weight_fee
inputs.question: Does the current source require using only the higher of oversize and overweight charges when both apply?

outputs.name: answer
outputs.description: Exact integer ticket price plus all current baggage fees.

reads.question: Read the current itinerary, cabin, bags, ticket price, complimentary entitlements, and every matched baggage-rule parameter needed to calculate the total.
reads.source_locator: current native view public.source_text, public.facts, and public.question

fields.name: ticket_price
fields.question: What integer ticket price is stated?

fields.name: bag_dimensions
fields.question: Return all bag dimensions as a flat numeric length-width-height array in listed order.

fields.name: bag_weights
fields.question: Return all bag weights as a flat numeric array in listed order.

fields.name: personal_item_limits
fields.question: Return the personal-item per-axis limits as a three-number array.

fields.name: carry_on_limits
fields.question: Return the carry-on per-axis limits as a three-number array.

fields.name: personal_item_count
fields.question: How many personal items are allowed?

fields.name: carry_on_count
fields.question: How many carry-on bags are allowed?

fields.name: checked_bag_fees
fields.question: Return the applicable ordinal checked-bag fees, ending with the reusable fourth-plus fee.

fields.name: complimentary_bag_count
fields.question: How many checked bags qualify for complimentary treatment under the current cabin, status, and itinerary?

fields.name: standard_dimension_limit
fields.question: What total-dimension limit applies?

fields.name: complimentary_weight_limit
fields.question: What weight limit applies to complimentary checked bags?

fields.name: charged_weight_limit
fields.question: What weight limit applies to excess charged checked bags?

fields.name: overweight_upper_bounds
fields.question: Return applicable overweight-band upper bounds in ascending order.

fields.name: overweight_fees
fields.question: Return the fees aligned with those overweight bounds.

fields.name: oversize_upper_bounds
fields.question: Return applicable oversize-band upper bounds in ascending order.

fields.name: oversize_fees
fields.question: Return the fees aligned with those oversize bounds.

fields.name: use_higher_size_or_weight_fee
fields.question: When both size and weight limits are exceeded, does the source charge only the higher fee?

source_obligations.statement: Exclude no more than the permitted personal item and carry-on bag when their per-axis dimensions fit; treat the remaining current bags as checked bags.

origin.quote: You're allowed 1 carry-on bag and 1 personal item in all cabins.

source_obligations.statement: For a checked bag exceeding both size and weight limits, add only the higher applicable oversize or overweight fee to its checked-bag fee.

origin.quote: The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.

source_obligations.statement: Sum the ticket, ordinal checked-bag fees, and applicable excess charges, assigning limited complimentary weight allowances to eligible bags so the entitlement is fully applied.

origin.quote: For all confirmed customers on flights to / from Australia or New Zealand: Dimension: 62 in / 158 cm; Weight: 70 lbs / 32kgs for complimentary bags and 50 lbs / 23 kgs for excess charged bags

source_provenance.quote: We calculate the size limits of your bag by adding the total outside dimensions of each bag, length + width + height.
The higher fee between oversize and overweight applies, in addition to the checked bag fee.
